children: Dell Technologies (DELL) shares jumped about 8% early Wednesday as its latest results showed accelerating demand for AI infrastructure and a broader recovery across its server business.

The company posted $47 billion in quarterly revenue, up 58% year over year, while net income increased 189% to $4.6 billion. Operating income reached $5.9 billion, helped by higher scale and a lower expense ratio.
AI server orders reached $60.9 billion during the quarter, with $16.4 billion recognized as revenue. Dell ended the period with a $95 billion AI backlog, while its AI customer base surpassed 6,500.

Infrastructure Solutions Group revenue hit a record $31.8 billion, including $10.5 billion from traditional servers and networking and $4.9 billion from storage. Client Solutions Group revenue totaled $15 billion.

Dell expects third-quarter revenue of $49 billion at the midpoint and non-GAAP EPS of $6.50. For fiscal 2027, it raised its revenue outlook to $192 billion and expects AI server revenue to triple to $74 billion.
What it means for the stock: The raised outlook and expanding AI backlog support the recent rally, although supply constraints and questions about margin durability remain key risks.

title: Dell Stock Soars on $95 Billion AI Backlog and Raised FY2027 Forecast
